description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process container management, including iterators for network interfaces, memory info, processor info, container info, and container producer within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over network interfaces, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics for a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU usage information for a container, including total usage and per-core usage.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container, with methods to get its type, ID, PID, memory and processor info, network interfaces, and control methods to start and stop the container.

classes.name: IContainerProducer
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing container instances, including initialization, deinitialization, and container creation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a running container within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container producer with a given configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.
